mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% signals aggressive monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS falling below 0.25% triggers a monetary easing cycle that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strengthening consumer demand, driving higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive returns in more than 50% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) with declining unemployment signals labor market recovery, boosting consumer spending and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.5% and UNRATE falls > 0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is above 5.5% and falling.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the past month indicates strengthening residential demand, correlating with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST rises above its 1-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 105 indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate profitability and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO is above 105.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent employment growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment decline (UNRATE) signal labor market tightening, increasing consumer spending and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive returns in more than 50% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 0.25% signals monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises above 0.25%.
